description.en: Open knowledge base of the world's mechanical door locks: identify the lock you have, record its dimensions, and design the smart-lock retrofit that fits it.
description.zh: 全球机械门锁开放知识库：识别你现有的锁、记录它的尺寸参数，并设计与之匹配的智能锁改造方案。

product._comment: Set `url` to publish a link to the commercial retrofit product site in the header, the footer and the identification result. Leave it empty and nothing renders — no empty hrefs, no placeholder link. Can be overridden at build time with PRODUCT_URL=… for testing.

note.en: This site is an independent public reference. Adapters and retrofit kits are made by the maintainers.
note.zh: 本站是独立的公益参考资料。适配件与改造套件由维护者生产。

noResults.en: No matches. Try a standard code (DIN 18251), a dimension (backset) or a brand.
noResults.zh: 没有匹配结果。可以试试标准号（DIN 18251）、尺寸名（backset 锁芯中心距）或品牌名。

tagline.en: A public-benefit reference for lock designers retrofitting the world's existing mechanical locks.
tagline.zh: 面向锁具设计师的公益参考资料，用于改造全球现存的机械门锁。

licenseText.en: Text and data are CC BY 4.0. Cite as “GlobalLockSummary” with a link. Brand names and standards codes belong to their owners.
licenseText.zh: 文字与数据采用 CC BY 4.0 许可，引用请注明 “GlobalLockSummary” 并附链接。品牌名与标准编号归各自权利人所有。

disclaimer.en: Reference data only. Verify against the original standard and a physical measurement before manufacturing, installing, or relying on any lock. Fire-rated and escape-route doors must keep a certified, mechanically operable egress path.
disclaimer.zh: 本站内容仅供参考。在制造、安装或依赖任何锁具前，请对照原始标准并实测确认。防火门与疏散通道门必须保留经认证的、可机械开启的逃生通道。
